description.value: Fleetwood Branch is one of ten Surrey Libraries locations serving the Fleetwood neighbourhood of Surrey, BC. As a public library, it offers free access to books, digital resources, computer terminals, and community programming. Touring cyclists may find it a useful urban rest stop with Wi-Fi and public-use computers available without admission.
